text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp is hitting a pretty confusing error trying to use the batching helper for embeddings + rerank. stack trace below.
ankur: seen it. what endpoint + sdk?
maria: node SDK, calling /embeddings then /rerank in the same request flow. Batcher merges two requests into one payload and server returns 400: \u201cvector length mismatch\u201d.
sam: can you paste the payload?
maria: short snippet: 
```json
{"batch": [{"model":"text-embed-768","input":"foo"},{"model":"text-embed-1536","input":"bar"}]}
```
lee: oh that explains it — the batching helper currently coalesces by time window, not by model/dim. If two different embed models are in-flight they get sent as a single batch envelope. server expects uniform dim per request.
ankur: ouch. and the rerank call?
maria: we then take embeddings from that batch and pass them to rerank; the rerank SDK expects a list of vectors with shape [N, D]. Some SDKs (node) were auto-padding to 1536 if any vector in the batch had that length, python left shapes as-is.
sam: parity bug — node mutates to a union dim, python keeps original. That causes intermittent 400s and then retry loop.
lee: and the retry code in sampleapp just re-enqueues the whole batch with a fresh auth token, which can cause duplicate processing + double billing.
ankur: reproduction steps?
maria: run sampleapp with mixed-model quickstart, enable batching helper, set batch window to 50ms. Fail occurs ~30% of runs.
sam: quick fix: guard batching helper to group by (model, expected_dim). Also validate vector dims before calling rerank and throw early with a helpful message.
lee: +1. Also add idempotency token on rerank requests so retries are deduped server-side. we have idempotency headers for generation endpoints already.
maria: logged a tiny patch on my branch. PR: 
https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/312
dev-bot: CI: sampleapp/unit-tests failed: embed-batcher should group-by-model (see logs).
ankur: tests are good. can we also make SDKs surface a helper util: "normalize_vectors(vs, target_dim)" that fails loudly if mismatch and optionally pads (opt-in) with zeros?
sam: prefer fail loudly by default. Padding is dangerous (hides mismatch). opt-in pad flag is fine for customers who accept approximate dims.
lee: for node sdk, the bug was subtle: when using TypedArrays + concat the final Float32Array length is coerced and we didn't assert divisibility by dim. added assert in my branch.
maria: i'm updating sampleapp to: group-by-model, assert dims, set idempotency, and short circuit retry on 4xx. will push shortly.
ankur: can we also improve error message from server to be "expected vector dim X but got Y for model Z"? right now it's just "vector length mismatch". that would speed DX.
sam: agreed — filing ticket for runtime team to make error messages model-aware and return field `expected_dim`.
lee: small UX/QoL: add a telemetry tag when batching helper coalesces mixed models so we can see how common this pattern is.
maria: pushed changes and updated sampleapp readme explaining that mixing embed models in the same batch is unsupported.
ankur: nice. can you add a short snippet to the SDK docs to show safe pattern?
maria: done. snippet: 
```js
// group-by model before batching
const groups = groupBy(inputs, i => i.model);
for (const [model, items] of Object.entries(groups)) {
  const vectors = await client.embeddings.create({model, input: items.map(x=>x.text)});
  // verify shapes before rerank
  assert(vectors.every(v => v.length === expectedDimFor(model)));
}
```
dev-bot: Reminder: please add changelog entries for sdk and sampleapp.
sam: one more thing: could the batching helper be made opt-in per client instance rather than global so sample apps don't accidentally enable it?
lee: makes sense. set batching: {enabled: false} by default in sampleapp starters.
maria: will ship a patch and follow up with a short migration note. thanks all :tada:
